LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_NARRA.en: %s announces its parliamentary election results. The Coast Coalition loses the majority it held for three terms, and the Reform Party makes lower housing taxes a condition of coalition talks.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_COMME.source: 组阁之前，每一票都像可以兑换的筹码。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_COMME.zh_CN: 海岸联盟丢了连续三届的多数席位，改革党把降低住房税摆上谈判桌。选举结果变了，新内阁能不能搭起来，还得看这项条件最终怎么谈。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_COMME.en: The Coast Coalition lost its three-term majority, and the Reform Party put lower housing taxes on the table. The voters have had their say, but forming a new cabinet still depends on what the parties can agree to in those talks.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NEGATIV.en: Only when the procurement records are released does the public learn where the missing money went

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_TITLE.source: 财政部公开逐笔采购账目
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_TITLE.zh_CN: 财政部开放五年采购明细
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_TITLE.en: Treasury releases five years of procurement records

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NARRATI.source: %s财政部开放过去五年的采购明细，民间会计发现三所学校向同一家空壳公司采购了相同编号的实验设备。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s财政部开放过去五年的采购明细，民间会计发现三所学校向同一家空壳公司采购了相同编号的实验设备。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NARRATI.en: %s's treasury releases five years of procurement records. Volunteer accountants find three schools bought laboratory equipment with identical serial numbers from one shell company.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_COMMENT.source: 数字本身很安静，重复的设备编号就不一样了。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_COMMENT.zh_CN: 三所学校的实验设备竟然用了同一个编号，还出自同一家空壳公司。财政部把五年明细放出来，民间会计才能顺着记录揪出这条线索。至于经费是怎么批出去的，还得接着往下查。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_COMMENT.en: Three schools ended up with lab equipment sharing the exact same serial number from one shell company. Opening five years of procurement records let volunteer accountants spot the match, and now someone has to explain how those payments were approved.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 地方居民终于能选出自己的议会
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_POSITIVE.en: Local residents can finally choose their own parliaments

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NEGATIVE.source: 边界画完了，养老金还没画完
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 议会日程定下了，跨区养老金却还没谈妥
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NEGATIVE.en: Parliament schedules are set, while cross-region pensions remain unresolved

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NARRATIV.source: %s的三个自治地区签署《白港协议》，约定一年内分别建立议会。共同货币暂留十八个月，跨区养老金的归属仍未谈妥。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NARRATIV.zh_CN: %s的三个自治地区签署《白港协议》，约定一年内分别建立议会。共同货币暂留十八个月，跨区养老金的归属仍未谈妥。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NARRATIV.en: Three autonomous regions in %s sign the Whiteharbor Agreement to establish separate parliaments within a year. Their common currency stays for eighteen months, while pension obligations remain disputed.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_COMMENT.source: 人们会先用新国旗讨论旧账单。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 一年内各自建立议会、共同货币暂留十八个月，日程已经写进《白港协议》。跨区养老金归谁管还没谈妥，这些安排总得说清楚，牵涉其中的人才能安心些。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_COMMENT.en: Separate parliaments within a year and eighteen more months of a shared currency give the Whiteharbor Agreement a timetable. Cross-region pensions remain unresolved, though. Until responsibility for them is settled, people who depend on those payments have reason to worry.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NEGATIV.en: The rule sweeps graduation photos of over ten people into the permit pile

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_TITLE.en: Interim cabinet requires advance approval for outdoor gatherings over ten

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NARRATI.source: %s临时内阁以港口骚乱为由，要求超过十人的户外集会提前报备。大学社团发现毕业合影也被列入审批范围。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s临时内阁以港口骚乱为由，要求超过十人的户外集会提前报备。大学社团发现毕业合影也被列入审批范围。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NARRATI.en: %s's interim cabinet requires advance approval for outdoor gatherings of more than ten people after unrest at a port. University clubs learn graduation photos also need permission.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_COMMENT.source: 限制越具体，反话越容易找到落脚点。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 临时内阁拿港口骚乱当理由，把超过十人的户外集会一并纳进报备范围。大学社团连拍张毕业合影都得先走审批，合影和骚乱被放进同一套规矩，反话可就不难说了。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_COMMENT.en: The interim cabinet cited unrest at the port, then required prior approval for outdoor gatherings of more than ten people. Once even a graduation photo needs clearance, the rule gives anyone inclined to sarcasm a very precise place to start counting.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_POSITIVE.source: 远郊居民终于不用为距离支付额外代价
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 改为每程固定收费后，远郊通勤者省下了月票开支
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_POSITIVE.en: A flat fare per trip saves outer-suburb commuters money on monthly passes

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NEGATIVE.source: 统一票价把两站路也统一成了远途
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 取消按里程计费后，短途乘客每程多花近一半车费
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NEGATIVE.en: Dropping distance-based fares makes short-trip riders pay nearly half again as much

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_TITLE.source: 新公共交通票价法案通过
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_TITLE.zh_CN: 议会通过公共交通固定票价方案
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_TITLE.en: Parliament replaces distance-based transit fares with flat rate

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NARRATIVE.source: %s议会取消按里程计费，改为每程固定收费。远郊通勤者省下月票钱，短途乘客的单程支出却增加近一半。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s议会取消按里程计费，改为每程固定收费。远郊通勤者省下月票钱，短途乘客的单程支出却增加近一半。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NARRATIVE.en: %s's parliament replaces distance-based transit fares with one flat fare per trip. Outer-suburb commuters save on monthly passes, while short-trip riders pay almost half again as much.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_COMMENT.source: 同一张票，远处的人和近处的人算出的账不同。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 按里程计费改成每程固定收费，远郊通勤的人省了月票钱，只坐短途的人单程支出却涨了近一半。两边谈起新票价，感受大概很难一样。要听懂他们在说什么，先问每天坐多远，倒比急着分对错有用。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_COMMENT.en: Replacing distance fares with a flat rate saves outer-suburb commuters money on monthly passes while raising the cost of a short ride by nearly half. Their reactions need not match. Before deciding who has misunderstood the rule, it helps to ask how far each person travels.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_POSITIVE.en: Border forces say the operation can prevent another cross-border attack

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NEGATIVE.en: Closed crossings and requisitioned trains leave border families less certain when they can go home

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_TITLE.source: 河谷停火协议在黎明破裂
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_TITLE.zh_CN: 边境河谷停火协议在第九天破裂
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_TITLE.en: Border-valley ceasefire breaks on ninth day

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NARRATIVE.source: %s边境河谷的停火协议在生效第九天破裂，双方关闭两处口岸并征用货运列车。当地救援站开始登记失散家庭。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s边境河谷的停火协议在生效第九天破裂，双方关闭两处口岸并征用货运列车。当地救援站开始登记失散家庭。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NARRATIVE.en: A ceasefire in %s's border valley breaks on its ninth day. Both sides close two crossings and requisition freight trains. Relief stations begin registering separated families.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_COMMENT.source: 战争新闻里的地名，会变成普通人的去向。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_COMMENT.zh_CN: 停火协议只撑了九天，两处口岸关闭，货运列车也被征用，边境的往来更难了。救援站已经开始登记失散家庭。对这些家庭来说，眼下最急的恐怕是弄清亲人在哪里。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_COMMENT.en: The ceasefire lasted only nine days before both sides closed two crossings and requisitioned freight trains. Relief stations are already registering separated families, so for those families the urgent question is where their relatives are.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_POSITIVE.en: Reversing gravity disrupts old tactics and gives newcomers a chance

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NARRATIVE.source: %s的灯塔工作室发布竞技游戏《玻璃海》，主打可改变重力的三人对战。首日服务器排队超过两小时，赛事方已宣布秋季邀请赛。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s的灯塔工作室发布竞技游戏《玻璃海》，主打可改变重力的三人对战。首日服务器排队超过两小时，赛事方已宣布秋季邀请赛。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NARRATIVE.en: Lighthouse Studio in %s releases Glass Sea, a three-player competitive game with reversible gravity. Launch queues exceed two hours, and an autumn invitational is announced.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_COMMENT.source: 排队的截图常常比第一场比赛先传出去。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_COMMENT.zh_CN: 《玻璃海》刚上线就宣布秋季邀请赛，可见赛事方对重力反转的三人对战很有信心。首日服务器排队超过两小时，想体验新打法的人，得先等到能进游戏再说。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_COMMENT.en: Glass Sea already has an autumn invitational on the calendar, showing plenty of confidence in its reversible-gravity matches. With first-day server queues passing two hours, though, eager players have a long wait before they can try the new mechanics.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_POSITIV.source: 五代租客让一间房容下了不同的人生

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_TITLE.zh_CN: 索娜独角戏《空房间》完成巡演新一站，下站加售门票
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_TITLE.en: Sona's Empty Rooms completes another tour stop; next stop adds tickets

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NARRATI.source: %s演员索娜带着独角戏《空房间》完成新一站演出。她不换布景便扮演五代租客，本场谢幕持续十七分钟，下一站门票也开始加售。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s演员索娜带着独角戏《空房间》完成新一站演出。她不换布景便扮演五代租客，本场谢幕持续十七分钟，下一站门票也开始加售。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NARRATI.en: Actor Sona takes her solo play Empty Rooms to another stop in %s. She plays five generations of tenants without changing the set. The curtain call lasts seventeen minutes, and more tickets go on sale for the next stop.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_COMMENT.source: 观众会把舞台上的房间带回自己的日常。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_COMMENT.zh_CN: 索娜不换布景就演活了五代租客，也难怪这一站谢幕能持续十七分钟。同一间屋子装进几代人的日子，住过出租屋的观众很容易在里面认出自己的经历，下一站加售顺理成章。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_COMMENT.en: Sona plays five generations of tenants without changing the set, which helps explain a seventeen-minute curtain call. Packing so many lives into one rented room gives audiences plenty to recognize from their own experience, and the next stop is already adding tickets.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_POSIT.en: A misdelivered will and an elusive narrator give readers a mystery to untangle together

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_NARRA.zh_CN: %s作家艾缇的新小说《第七码头》在发行前售罄，故事从一封寄错地址的遗嘱展开。书店安排通宵签售，读者争论叙述者是否存在。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_NARRA.en: Writer Aeti's The Seventh Pier sells out before release in %s. Its story begins with a will sent to the wrong address. Bookshops plan overnight signings as readers dispute whether its narrator exists.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_COMME.source: 一本书的争论，会写出书外的另一段故事。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_COMME.zh_CN: 《第七码头》还没正式发行就卖空了，书店也安排了通宵签售。一封寄错地址的遗嘱本来就够抓人，读者又在争论叙述者到底存不存在，难怪会让人想拉个朋友一块猜。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_COMME.en: The Seventh Pier sold out before release, and bookshops have scheduled overnight signings. A will sent to the wrong address is hook enough, and the dispute over whether the narrator even exists gives readers a puzzle to argue through together.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_POSITI.source: 小制作也能让观众围绕一句台词共同创作
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_POSITI.zh_CN: 小制作也能给观众留下一句接着创作的台词
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_POSITI.en: A small production gives audiences one line to build on

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NEGATI.source: 看完电影后，所有告别都开始需要查票
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NEGATI.zh_CN: 同一句告别说了又说，照片里的人影却只减不增
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NEGATI.en: The clerk repeats the same farewell while the photograph loses one passenger after another

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_TITLE.source: 电影《纸月车站》刷新本土票房纪录
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_TITLE.zh_CN: 低成本电影《纸月车站》连续三周领跑票房
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_TITLE.en: Low-budget film Paper Moon Station leads box office for three weeks

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NARRAT.source: %s上映的低成本电影《纸月车站》连续三周登顶票房。片中售票员每次说完同一句告别语，就有一位乘客从照片中消失。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NARRAT.zh_CN: %s上映的低成本电影《纸月车站》连续三周登顶票房。片中售票员每次说完同一句告别语，就有一位乘客从照片中消失。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NARRAT.en: Low-budget film Paper Moon Station leads %s's box office for three weeks. Each time its ticket clerk repeats a farewell, another passenger vanishes from a photograph.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_COMMEN.source: 重复的台词给不同场景留出了入口。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_COMMEN.zh_CN: 《纸月车站》成本不高，却连着三周拿了票房第一。售票员每说一次那句告别语，照片里就少一名乘客，这个设定简单又揪心，观众出了影院也很难忘掉。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_COMMEN.en: Paper Moon Station was made on a small budget, yet it has led the box office for three straight weeks. Every time the ticket clerk repeats that farewell, another passenger vanishes from the photo—a simple, unsettling device that stays with viewers after they leave.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_POSITI.source: 旧船坞成了普通人能走进去的公共记忆
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_POSITI.zh_CN: 旧船坞变成了游客可以走进去的共同记忆
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_POSITI.en: An old dock becomes a shared memory visitors can enter

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NEGATI.source: 未来的自己先收到今天的门票账单
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NEGATI.zh_CN: 修好园区花了七年，寄给未来的明信片却只给一小时写完
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NEGATI.en: The park took seven years to build, then gave visitors one hour to write to the future

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_TITLE.source: 云鲸主题公园开放夜间园区
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_TITLE.zh_CN: 云鲸主题公园开放旧船坞夜间园区
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_TITLE.en: Cloud Whale theme park opens night district along old dock

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NARRAT.source: %s的云鲸主题公园完成七年建设，开放沿旧船坞铺设的夜间园区。最受关注的项目要求游客在一小时内寄出给未来自己的明信片。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NARRAT.zh_CN: %s的云鲸主题公园完成七年建设，开放沿旧船坞铺设的夜间园区。最受关注的项目要求游客在一小时内寄出给未来自己的明信片。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NARRAT.en: After seven years of construction, Cloud Whale opens a night district along an old dock in %s. Its most discussed attraction gives visitors one hour to mail a postcard to their future selves.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_COMMEN.source: 景点越有仪式感，游客越会带走一套动作。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_COMMEN.zh_CN: 云鲸主题公园修了七年，终于开放这片旧船坞夜间园区，其中最受关注的是给未来自己的明信片。项目只留一小时寄出，倒计时催人落笔，写给未来的自己，又难免多想一会儿。等收到信时，还会记得当时为什么写下那些话吗？
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_COMMEN.en: Cloud Whale spent seven years building this night district along the old dock, and its most discussed attraction gives visitors an hour to mail a postcard to their future selves. Writing to your future self can take a little thought, even with a clock running. Will they remember why they chose those words when the card arrives?

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_POSITIVE.source: 业余球队让冠军与普通劳动者连在一起
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 快递员球队补时逆转夺冠，奖金还能修好借用的学校球场
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_POSITIVE.en: Delivery riders win in added time and use the prize to repair a borrowed school pitch

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NEGATIVE.source: 职业球队输给了一群还要赶晚班的人
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 职业球队在补时阶段被业余的灰鸥队反超丢冠
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NEGATIVE.en: A professional club lets the title slip in added time against amateur riders

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_TITLE.source: 屋顶联赛决赛由业余球队夺冠
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_TITLE.zh_CN: 快递员组成的灰鸥队补时反超夺得屋顶联赛冠军
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_TITLE.en: Delivery riders' Grey Gulls win Rooftop League final in added time

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NARRATIVE.source: %s屋顶联赛的决赛中，由快递员组成的灰鸥队在补时反超职业球队。夺冠奖金将用来修复他们长期借用的学校球场。
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s屋顶联赛的决赛中，由快递员组成的灰鸥队在补时反超职业球队。夺冠奖金将用来修复他们长期借用的学校球场。
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NARRATIVE.en: In %s's Rooftop League final, the Grey Gulls, a team of delivery riders, beat a professional side in added time. Their prize will repair the school pitch they have long borrowed.

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_COMMENT.source: 人们会记住最后一球，也会记住谁明天还要上班。
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_COMMENT.zh_CN: 一群快递员组成的灰鸥队在补时阶段反超职业队，拿到冠军后先想着修好长期借用的学校球场。赢球本身就够提气，奖金去向又这么实在，听见消息的人很难不为他们高兴。
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_COMMENT.en: The Grey Gulls—a team of delivery riders—beat a professional side in added time and earmarked the prize money to repair the school pitch they have long borrowed. The comeback alone is exciting, and putting the winnings back into that field makes them easy to root for.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_POSITIVE.source: 救援队和民间车队正在共同疏散居民
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 救援队与民间车队正沿山路共同转运受困居民
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_POSITIVE.en: Rescue teams and volunteer drivers evacuate stranded residents together along mountain roads

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NEGATIVE.source: 百年一遇的洪水又赶上了今年
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 预警模型再度低估上游汇水，连续降雨又把铁路逼停
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NEGATIVE.en: The warning model underestimated upstream runoff again as five days of rain halted rail service

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_TITLE.source: 持续暴雨中断北岭铁路运输
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_TITLE.zh_CN: 北岭流域连日降雨致铁路再度停运
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_TITLE.en: Five days of rain halt North Ridge rail service again

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NARRATIVE.source: %s北岭流域连续五天降雨，落石与涨水使铁路再度停运。气象局称预警模型仍低估上游汇水，救援车辆沿山路转运受困居民。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s北岭流域连续五天降雨，落石与涨水使铁路再度停运。气象局称预警模型仍低估上游汇水，救援车辆沿山路转运受困居民。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NARRATIVE.en: Five days of rain bring rockfalls and rising water, disrupting North Ridge rail services again in %s. The weather service says its warning model still underestimates upstream runoff. Rescue vehicles evacuate stranded residents along mountain roads.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_COMMENT.source: 灾情里传播得快的，往往是求助地点和一句问责。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_COMMENT.zh_CN: 北岭流域连下五天雨，落石和涨水又把铁路逼停了，救援车正沿山路转运受困居民。眼下先得把人平安接出来。气象局说模型仍低估了上游汇水，等这轮救援过去，这个偏差也得接着查。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_COMMENT.en: Five days of rain brought rockfalls and rising water that shut down North Ridge rail service again, leaving rescue vehicles to evacuate residents along mountain roads. The weather service admits its model still underestimates upstream runoff, a gap that will need fixing.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_POSITIVE.source: 停工令承认高温下劳动者需要保护
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 劳动部门下达午后露天停工令，承认高温下需要停工保护
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_POSITIVE.en: Officials order an afternoon halt to outdoor work during the nine-day heatwave

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NEGATIVE.source: 太阳已经下班，计时器还在加班
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 连着九天超四十度，平台时限不改，骑手还得晒超时罚单
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NEGATIVE.en: Nine days above forty degrees, yet delivery platforms keep their deadlines and issue late penalties

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_TITLE.source: 热浪触发新一轮户外停工令
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_TITLE.zh_CN: 南部高温持续九天，骑手晒出超时罚单
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_TITLE.en: Riders post heatwave late penalties as officials announce afternoon outdoor work ban

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NARRATIVE.source: %s南部连续九天气温超过四十度，劳动部门宣布新一轮午后露天停工令。送货平台仍按原时限考核，骑手开始公开晒出这轮高温中的超时罚单。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s南部连续九天气温超过四十度，劳动部门宣布新一轮午后露天停工令。送货平台仍按原时限考核，骑手开始公开晒出这轮高温中的超时罚单。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NARRATIVE.en: After nine days above forty degrees in southern %s, officials announce another suspension of afternoon outdoor work. Delivery platforms keep their deadlines, and riders publish the late-delivery penalties received during this heatwave.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_COMMENT.source: 天气会变成劳动议题，因为有人无法躲进室内。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_COMMENT.zh_CN: 南部连着九天超过四十度，劳动部门发了午后露天停工令，送货平台却还按原时限考核。骑手把高温里的超时罚单晒出来，这两套要求摆到一起，矛盾就很清楚了：让人停下来，考核也不能还催着人赶路。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_COMMENT.en: After nine days above forty degrees, labor officials ordered another afternoon halt to outdoor work, yet delivery platforms kept their original deadlines. Riders are publishing the late penalties they received in the heat, asking whether the order applies to platform timers too.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_POSITIVE.source: 公共空间短暂让位给所有人都能看的天空
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 市政熄灭河岸广告屏、学校借出望远镜，方便市民凌晨看彗星
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_POSITIVE.en: Switched-off riverside screens and borrowed school telescopes help residents watch the comet

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NEGATIVE.source: 彗星路过两小时，广告屏终于休息两小时
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 河岸广告屏肯熄灯两小时，还得靠彗星路过
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NEGATIVE.en: It took a passing comet to get the riverside ad screens turned off for two hours

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_TITLE.source: 蓝尾彗星将在周末掠过近地轨道
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_TITLE.zh_CN: 穹顶天文台公布周末凌晨蓝尾彗星观测窗口
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_TITLE.en: Dome Observatory announces weekend pre-dawn viewing window for blue-tail comet

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NARRATIVE.source: %s穹顶天文台公布蓝尾彗星的观测窗口，周末凌晨可用肉眼看见。市政部门同意熄灭河岸广告屏两小时，学校借出望远镜。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s穹顶天文台公布蓝尾彗星的观测窗口，周末凌晨可用肉眼看见。市政部门同意熄灭河岸广告屏两小时，学校借出望远镜。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NARRATIVE.en: The Dome Observatory in %s announces a blue-tail comet will be visible before dawn this weekend. Riverside advertising screens go dark for two hours, and schools lend telescopes.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_COMMENT.source: 罕见的同一片天空，很容易成为共同记忆。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_COMMENT.zh_CN: 蓝尾彗星周末凌晨肉眼就能看见，市政部门答应关掉河岸广告屏两小时，学校也把望远镜借了出来。广告少亮一会儿，想看彗星的人就多一份方便。市政和学校能在这件事上配合起来，倒挺让人高兴。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_COMMENT.en: The blue-tail comet will be visible to the naked eye before dawn this weekend, with riverside ad screens going dark for two hours and schools lending out telescopes. Those arrangements give people a clearer view and a chance to look more closely, a welcome bit of coordination for the night sky.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_POSITIVE.source: 开放果园让受损收成仍能被邻里分享
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 果农开放受灾果园，让居民把落果捡回家免得白白烂掉
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_POSITIVE.en: Growers open frost-hit orchards so residents can gather fallen pears

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NEGATIVE.source: 果农还没赚到，水果已经先涨价了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 初霜毁了过半青梨，批发市场转头就拉高了鲜果报价
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NEGATIVE.en: Early frost ruins over half the green pears as wholesale markets raise fresh-fruit prices

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_TITLE.source: 异常早霜使果园提前停收
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_TITLE.zh_CN: 东部果园提前三周遭初霜，青梨损失过半
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_TITLE.en: Early frost hits eastern orchards three weeks ahead of schedule

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NARRATIVE.source: %s东部果园提前三周遭遇初霜，青梨收成损失过半。果农开放受损果园让居民自取落果，批发市场却同时上调鲜果报价。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s东部果园提前三周遭遇初霜，青梨收成损失过半。果农开放受损果园让居民自取落果，批发市场却同时上调鲜果报价。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NARRATIVE.en: Frost reaches eastern %s's orchards three weeks early, destroying over half the green-pear crop. Growers invite residents to collect fallen fruit while wholesalers raise fresh-fruit prices.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_COMMENT.source: 人们讨论季节，也会讨论谁替坏天气买单。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_COMMENT.zh_CN: 初霜提前三周落下来，青梨毁了一半还多。果农索性开门让居民自取落果，批发市场却在这时候上调鲜果报价，两边一对照，大伙儿自然会惦记果农这一季怎么熬过去。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_COMMENT.en: Frost arrived three weeks early and wiped out more than half the green-pear crop. Growers opened their orchards so residents could gather fallen fruit, while wholesale markets raised fresh-fruit prices—a contrast that leaves people worrying about how the growers will get through the season.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_POSITIVE.source: 限水能让家庭保住基本生活用水
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 分时供水有助于维持居民的基本生活用水
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_POSITIVE.en: Timed rationing helps preserve households' basic water supply

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NEGATIVE.source: 旧城露出了钟，酒店还没到停水时间
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 水库降到七十年最低，居民还得催湖岸酒店停掉泳池补水
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NEGATIVE.en: The reservoir hits a seventy-year low while residents press lakeside hotels to stop filling pools

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_TITLE.source: 七十年来最低水位暴露沉没旧城
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_TITLE.zh_CN: 西部水库降至七十年最低水位，水下旧城钟楼露出
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_TITLE.en: Western reservoir hits seventy-year low, exposing submerged bell tower

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NARRATIVE.source: %s西部水库降至七十年来最低水位，水下旧城的钟楼重新露出。供水公司开始分时供水，居民要求停止湖岸酒店泳池补水。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s西部水库降至七十年来最低水位，水下旧城的钟楼重新露出。供水公司开始分时供水，居民要求停止湖岸酒店泳池补水。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NARRATIVE.en: A western reservoir in %s reaches its lowest level in seventy years, revealing a submerged bell tower. Water rationing begins, and residents demand hotels stop filling their pools.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_COMMENT.source: 旱情会把水位和社会地位放在同一张照片里。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_COMMENT.zh_CN: 水库退到七十年来最低，连水下旧城的钟楼都露出来了。居民家里已经开始分时供水，湖岸酒店的泳池再接着补水，任谁看了都会问一句凭什么。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_COMMENT.en: The reservoir has dropped to a seventy-year low, exposing the bell tower of a submerged old town. With households already on timed water rationing, it is no wonder residents are demanding that lakeside hotels stop refilling their pools.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_POSITIVE.source: 公开检测让罕见天气有了可核查的解释
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 公开检测，为暗红色降雪给出可核查的解释
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_POSITIVE.en: Published tests give the unusual red snow a checkable explanation

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NEGATIVE.source: 雪都换颜色了，通知还没换模板
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 暗红色的雪已经落下，事前却没有气象提示
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NEGATIVE.en: Dark-red snow fell without any advance weather alert

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_TITLE.source: 红色降雪引发学校停课
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_TITLE.zh_CN: 高地多座城镇降下暗红色雪，学校停课待检
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_TITLE.en: Dark-red snow closes schools across several highland towns

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NARRATIVE.source: %s高地多座城镇降下暗红色雪，学校停课等待检测。研究站确认颜色来自高空沙尘，居民仍在追问为何没有提前收到气象提示。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s高地多座城镇降下暗红色雪，学校停课等待检测。研究站确认颜色来自高空沙尘，居民仍在追问为何没有提前收到气象提示。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NARRATIVE.en: Dark-red snow closes schools in several highland towns in %s. A research station traces the color to airborne dust, while residents ask why no weather alert was issued.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_COMMENT.source: 罕见景象带来好奇，通知迟到带来别的含义。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_COMMENT.zh_CN: 研究站查清了暗红色雪来自高空沙尘，异常的颜色总算有了解释。学校为这场降雪停了课，居民再追问为什么没有提前收到气象提示，也很正常；原因查明了，预警的事还得另作答复。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_COMMENT.en: The research station has traced the dark-red snow to airborne dust, giving the unusual color an explanation. Schools have already had to close while waiting for tests, so residents have good reason to ask why no warning came beforehand. Finding the cause does not answer that question.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_POSITIVE.source: 自动化能提高公共服务效率，也能降低创作门槛
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 自动化能提高公共服务效率，也让创作工具更容易用上
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_POSITIVE.en: Automation can speed up public services and make creative tools more accessible

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NEGATIVE.source: 机器替我写了申请，也替人决定我能否获批
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 设计公司忙着缩减外包，政府采购部门也拿它试着自动审件
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NEGATIVE.en: Design firms cut freelance work while government buyers test automated review

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_TITLE.source: 生成式人工智能“织灯”向公众开放
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_TITLE.zh_CN: 镜海实验室免费公开生成式人工智能“织灯”
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_TITLE.en: Mirrorsea Labs releases free generative AI Weavelight

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NARRATIVE.source: %s的镜海实验室公开生成式人工智能“织灯”，免费提供文字、图像和语音生成。设计公司宣布缩减外包，政府采购部门则试用自动审件。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s的镜海实验室公开生成式人工智能“织灯”，免费提供文字、图像和语音生成。设计公司宣布缩减外包，政府采购部门则试用自动审件。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NARRATIVE.en: Mirrorsea Labs in %s releases Weavelight, offering free text, image, and voice generation. Design firms announce fewer freelance contracts, while government buyers test automated application review.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_COMMENT.source: 同一项技术，会被当作能力、饭碗或审查员。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_COMMENT.zh_CN: “织灯”免费提供文字、图像和语音生成，听着确实能省些工夫。设计公司已经宣布缩减外包，靠接单吃饭的人，恐怕很难只为这份方便高兴。政府采购部门还在试用自动审件，这种方便要怎么用，也得慢慢看清楚。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_COMMENT.en: Weavelight offers free text, image and voice generation, which sounds useful. Design firms have announced fewer freelance contracts, so someone who lives on that work may find the convenience hard to celebrate. Government buyers are testing automated review too; how these tools are used deserves as much attention as what they can produce.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_POSITIVE.source: 长期投入和公开复核解决了跨越几代人的问题
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 九十六页证明经三个独立小组逐行复核，这道数学难题有了解答
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_POSITIVE.en: Three independent teams verify the ninety-six-page proof line by line

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NEGATIVE.source: 人类证出了猜想，我还拆不明白这个月的账单
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 猜想证出来了，九十六页证明还是没让我少皱一点眉头
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NEGATIVE.en: The conjecture is proved; getting through ninety-six pages is still another matter

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_TITLE.source: 罗比拉齐猜想的完整证明通过复核
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_TITLE.zh_CN: 数学家维索公布罗比拉齐猜想证明并通过三组复核
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_TITLE.en: Mathematician Viso's proof of Robilazzi conjecture passes three independent reviews

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NARRATIV.source: %s数学家伊莱娜·维索公布罗比拉齐猜想的九十六页证明：所有充分大的偶数都能拆成两个素数之和。三个独立小组完成逐行复核。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NARRATIV.zh_CN: %s数学家伊莱娜·维索公布罗比拉齐猜想的九十六页证明：所有充分大的偶数都能拆成两个素数之和。三个独立小组完成逐行复核。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NARRATIV.en: Mathematician Ilena Viso in %s publishes a ninety-six-page proof of the Robilazzi conjecture: every sufficiently large even integer is a sum of two primes. Three independent teams check it line by line.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_COMMENT.source: 能看懂证明的人不多，能借题发挥的人会多得多。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_COMMENT.zh_CN: 九十六页的推导过程未必人人读得懂，但“所有充分大的偶数都能拆成两个素数之和”倒不难记。三个独立小组已经逐行复核完，结论有了着落。至于拿这句话说笑，懂不懂完整证明，恐怕都能接上两句。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_COMMENT.en: Not everyone will follow all ninety-six pages, but the statement that every sufficiently large even integer is a sum of two primes is easier to remember. Three independent teams have checked the proof line by line. Borrowing that statement for a joke does not require the same work as proving it.

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_POSITIVE.source: 低能耗离线计算让个人设备少依赖云端
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 低能耗离线计算有望让个人设备少依赖云端
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_POSITIVE.en: Low-power offline computing could make personal devices less dependent on the cloud

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NEGATIVE.source: 设备薄了一半，工资要攒两月
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 掌心大小的新终端，首批售价顶得上普通职员两个月工资
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NEGATIVE.en: A palm-sized terminal launches at two months of an ordinary clerk's pay

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_TITLE.source: 折叠式光算终端“萤石”发布
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_TITLE.zh_CN: 铄光公司发布低能耗光算终端“萤石”
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_TITLE.en: Shineglass releases low-power optical terminal Fluorite

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NARRATIVE.source: %s铄光公司发布掌心大小的光算终端“萤石”，宣称离线语音识别能耗降至旧款十分之一。首批售价相当于普通职员两个月工资。
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s铄光公司发布掌心大小的光算终端“萤石”，宣称离线语音识别能耗降至旧款十分之一。首批售价相当于普通职员两个月工资。
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NARRATIVE.en: Shineglass in %s announces Fluorite, a palm-sized optical terminal claiming offline speech recognition at one tenth the previous model's energy use. It costs two months of an ordinary clerk's pay.

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_COMMENT.source: 发布会说的是性能，评论区算的是工资。
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_COMMENT.zh_CN: 按厂商的说法，“萤石”能把离线语音识别的能耗压到旧款十分之一，单看参数确实亮眼。首批售价却相当于普通职员两个月工资，真要决定买不买，这个数字恐怕比参数更难绕过去。
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_COMMENT.en: Fluorite claims offline speech recognition at one-tenth the energy use of the previous model, which is impressive on paper. The first batch costs two months of an ordinary clerk's pay, though. Anyone thinking of buying one has another number to consider alongside the performance claims.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_POSITIV.source: 自动运输减少危险路段的驾驶时间
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_POSITIV.zh_CN: 自动货运能减少司机在危险路段的驾驶时间
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_POSITIV.en: Automated freight can reduce drivers' time on dangerous stretches of road

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NEGATIV.source: 车可以无人，失业名单还得有人填
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NEGATIV.zh_CN: 线路扩张了，工会追问转岗名额和夜间故障该由谁值守
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NEGATIV.en: Routes expand, and unions want answers on retraining slots and human night-shift cover

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_TITLE.source: 无人货运公路试点新增线路
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_TITLE.zh_CN: 无人货运试点新增三条公路，工会要求公布转岗名额
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_TITLE.en: Driverless freight pilot adds three roads as unions demand retraining slots

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NARRATI.source: %s交通部门为无人货运试点新增三条普通公路，这批订单仍由港口仓储商承接。工会要求随线路扩张公布转岗名额，并为夜间故障保留人工值守。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s交通部门为无人货运试点新增三条普通公路，这批订单仍由港口仓储商承接。工会要求随线路扩张公布转岗名额，并为夜间故障保留人工值守。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NARRATI.en: Transport officials in %s add three public roads to a driverless freight pilot, with port warehouses handling this round of orders. Unions demand retraining slots alongside the expansion and human night-shift fault response.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_COMMENT.source: 技术落地之后，抽象效率会变成具体的班表。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_COMMENT.zh_CN: 无人货运试点又添了三条普通公路，这批订单还是交由港口仓储商承接。工会盯着转岗名额和夜间故障的人工值守不放，也是怕线路越扩越快，原来的司机和检修工却没了着落。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_COMMENT.en: The driverless freight pilot just added three more public roads, with port warehouses still handling the orders. Unions are pressing for retraining slots and human night-shift fault crews because route expansion means little to workers if their jobs are left hanging.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_POSITIVE.source: 跨机构样本验证让陌生生命进入公共知识
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 样本送往两所外地实验室，让这种陌生生命能被跨机构核验
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_POSITIVE.en: Sending samples to two outside labs lets other institutions verify this unfamiliar form of life

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NEGATIVE.source: 植物学会了不晒太阳，我还没学会不加班
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 洞穴深处的蕨类靠微弱化学能就能活，听着像在形容苦撑的人
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NEGATIVE.en: A cave fern living on faint chemical energy without sunlight sounds uncomfortably relatable

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_TITLE.source: 洞穴深处发现透明蕨类新物种
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_TITLE.zh_CN: 远山大学在石灰岩洞穴发现透明蕨类“璃叶”
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_TITLE.en: Farhill University discovers transparent cave fern Glassleaf

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NARRATIVE.source: %s远山大学在石灰岩洞穴发现透明蕨类“璃叶”，它借助共生细菌利用微弱化学能。样本已送往两所外地实验室，洞穴暂时限制游客进入。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s远山大学在石灰岩洞穴发现透明蕨类“璃叶”，它借助共生细菌利用微弱化学能。样本已送往两所外地实验室，洞穴暂时限制游客进入。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NARRATIVE.en: Farhill University in %s finds a transparent fern called Glassleaf using weak chemical energy through symbiotic bacteria. Two outside laboratories receive samples, and tourist access to the cave is restricted.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_COMMENT.source: 新物种给人们提供了一种新的自我比喻。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_COMMENT.zh_CN: “璃叶”靠共生细菌利用微弱化学能，在洞穴里也能活下来。两所外地实验室已经收到样本，具体怎么回事还得细看；光是这种不见阳光的活法，就够人拿来形容自己的日子了。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_COMMENT.en: Glassleaf survives in a limestone cave by drawing on weak chemical energy through symbiotic bacteria. Two outside labs have received samples to examine. For anyone inclined to borrow the image, though, a plant living without sunlight already offers a way to talk about their own days.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_POSITIVE.source: 公开能耗让可重复的进展有了明确尺度
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 向电网持续供电十分钟并公开全部能耗数据，进展与短板都摆在明处
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_POSITIVE.en: Supplying the grid for ten minutes and publishing full energy data sets a transparent benchmark

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NEGATIVE.source: 未来供电十分钟，今天的电费一分没少
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 点火设备仍需外部供电，商业化计划也还没获批
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NEGATIVE.en: Ignition still needs outside power, and commercial operation has not been approved

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_TITLE.source: 首座聚变试验站维持供电十分钟
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_TITLE.zh_CN: 白环试验站首次向电网供电十分钟并公开能耗数据
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_TITLE.en: White Ring station supplies grid for ten minutes and releases full energy data

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NARRATIVE.source: %s白环试验站首次向电网持续供电十分钟。科研署公开全部能耗数据，指出点火设备仍需外部供电，商业化计划尚未获批。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s白环试验站首次向电网持续供电十分钟。科研署公开全部能耗数据，指出点火设备仍需外部供电，商业化计划尚未获批。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NARRATIVE.en: The White Ring trial station in %s supplies the grid for ten minutes. The agency publishes all energy data: ignition still draws outside power, and commercial operation has not been approved.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_COMMENT.source: 实验的十分钟，足够被讲成不同的未来。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_COMMENT.zh_CN: 白环试验站第一次向电网持续供电十分钟，科研署也把能耗数据全公开了。报告里明写着点火设备还得靠外部供电、商业化也没获批，想夸突破或想泼冷水的人，都能从这份数据里挑出半句来用。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_COMMENT.en: The White Ring station supplied the grid for ten minutes for the first time, and the agency published all of its energy data. Because the report also notes that ignition still needs outside power and commercial plans remain unapproved, both boosters and skeptics have material to quote.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_POSI.source: 可查证的原图能纠正流传的错误信息
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_POSI.zh_CN: 可查证的原图，能帮人核对流传的信息
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_POSI.en: A verifiable original lets readers check the information being circulated

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NEGA.source: 原图找到了，吵架的路还很长
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NEGA.zh_CN: 原图编号都查清了，两个论坛还在为图例截掉一半吵个不停
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NEGA.en: Even with the archive number verified, the two forums keep fighting over a cropped legend

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_TITL.source: 两大论坛再因史料真伪爆发骂战
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_TITL.zh_CN: 石阶论坛与潮汐论坛因百年前地图截图再起争执
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_TITL.en: Stone Steps and Tide forums clash again over cropped century-old map

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NARR.source: %s石阶论坛与潮汐论坛围绕一张新公开的百年前地图再次争吵。原图馆藏编号查明后，双方仍争论对方为何只截取图例一半。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NARR.zh_CN: %s石阶论坛与潮汐论坛围绕一张新公开的百年前地图再次争吵。原图馆藏编号查明后，双方仍争论对方为何只截取图例一半。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NARR.en: Stone Steps and Tide forums in %s renew their feud over a newly released century-old map. Even after its archive number is verified, users argue about why the other side cropped half the legend.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_COMM.source: 找到出处能解决证据问题，未必解决站队问题。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_COMM.zh_CN: 百年前的老地图连馆藏编号都查清了，石阶论坛和潮汐论坛还是没停手。两边现在追问对方为什么只截一半图例，出处本身已经不够回答这个问题；被裁掉的那一半，也得放回来看看。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_COMM.en: Even after the archive number of that century-old map was verified, Stone Steps and Tide kept right on fighting. Both forums are asking why the other side cropped half the legend. Knowing the source does not answer that on its own; the missing half still needs to be considered.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_POS.source: 清理批量操纵能减少虚假声量
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_POS.zh_CN: 清理协同操纵，有助于减少批量制造的虚假声量
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_POS.en: Removing coordinated manipulation can reduce fabricated popularity

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NEG.source: 机器人还在发言，新闻档案先闭嘴了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NEG.zh_CN: 判定阈值不公开，连独立媒体新建的新闻归档号也一起被冻结
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NEG.en: With thresholds kept secret, newly created news archive accounts get frozen in the same sweep

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_TIT.source: 广场网新一轮清理封禁大量账号
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_TIT.zh_CN: 广场网封禁约二十万账号，独立媒体称归档号也遭冻结
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_TIT.en: SquareNet bans roughly 200,000 accounts; outlets say news archives were frozen too

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NAR.zh_CN: %s广场网在新一轮清理中以“协同操纵”为由封禁约二十万账号，仍未公开判定阈值。独立媒体称其新建的新闻归档账号也在本轮被冻结。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NAR.en: SquareNet in %s bans roughly two hundred thousand accounts for coordinated manipulation in another moderation sweep, still withholding its thresholds. Independent outlets say their newly created news archive accounts were frozen in this round too.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_COM.source: 封号会缩小渠道，也会让剩下的表达更绕。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_COM.zh_CN: 广场网这一轮以“协同操纵”为由封了约二十万账号，判定阈值却还是不公开。独立媒体说，他们刚建的新闻归档号也被冻住了。要让人相信清理的标准，至少得说清楚这些账号为什么也在其中。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_COM.en: SquareNet banned roughly two hundred thousand accounts for coordinated manipulation while still keeping its detection thresholds secret. Now independent outlets say their newly created news archive accounts were frozen in the same sweep, raising questions about what those rules actually catch.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_POSI.en: A nonprofit archive negotiating a public mirror could save nineteen years of public pages

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_NARR.zh_CN: %s运营十九年的“回声巷”宣布三十天后关站。用户只能逐页导出旧帖，非营利档案团体协商接收公共页面镜像。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_NARR.en: Echo Lane announces closure after nineteen years in %s, giving users thirty days. Posts can be exported only page by page, and a nonprofit negotiates a mirror of public pages.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_COMM.source: 平台关闭时，人们才看清关系寄存在哪些按钮里。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_COMM.zh_CN: “回声巷”开了十九年，说关站只留三十天，旧帖还只能逐页导出。公共页面的镜像还在协商，想先把自己的帖子留住，就得趁这段时间动手，逐页往外导也实在费工夫。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_COMM.en: Echo Lane is shutting down after nineteen years with only thirty days’ notice, and users can export old posts only page by page. A nonprofit is still negotiating a mirror for public pages, so anyone who wants to keep their own copy now has those thirty days to work through the export.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_POSIT.source: 普通劳动者可以自己决定如何被看见

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_POSIT.en: A night cleaner films the dawn journey home and decides how that life is shown

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NEGAT.en: Without a word of narration, the dawn commute shows how little energy the night shift leaves behind

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_TITLE.en: Night cleaner's phone-shot film After the Night Shift draws platform recommendations

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NARRA.source: %s一位夜班清洁工用手机发布纪录短片系列《夜班之后》的新一集。影片没有旁白，只有十六段清晨回家路上的固定镜头，多家平台开始推荐本集。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NARRA.zh_CN: %s一位夜班清洁工用手机发布纪录短片系列《夜班之后》的新一集。影片没有旁白，只有十六段清晨回家路上的固定镜头，多家平台开始推荐本集。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NARRA.en: A night cleaner in %s releases another episode of the phone-shot documentary series After the Night Shift. It has no narration, only sixteen fixed shots on the journey home at dawn. Several platforms begin recommending the episode.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_COMME.source: 没有旁白的画面，也会让人写出很多句子。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_COMME.zh_CN: 《夜班之后》新一集连一句旁白都没有，只放了十六段清晨回家路上的固定镜头。多家平台开始推荐它，画面里没替人把感受说尽，上过夜班或赶过早路的人，也就有了认出自己经历的余地。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_COMME.en: The new episode of After the Night Shift has no narration at all, just sixteen fixed phone shots on the way home at dawn. Several platforms have started recommending it. Without a voice spelling out how to feel, viewers have room to recognize something of their own early journeys in those images.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_POSITIVE.source: 共同协议让朋友不再被不同平台隔开

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_POSITIVE.en: Messaging across services from an existing account spares users from juggling apps

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_TITLE.source: 聊天软件“线桥”开放跨平台协议
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_TITLE.zh_CN: 聊天软件“线桥”开放互通，两家大型平台拒绝接入
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_TITLE.en: Chat app Threadbridge opens cross-service messaging as two major platforms refuse access

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NARRATIVE.source: %s聊天软件“线桥”允许用户保留账号与其他服务互发消息。两家大型平台拒绝接入，理由是无法核验第三方客户端身份。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s聊天软件“线桥”允许用户保留账号与其他服务互发消息。两家大型平台拒绝接入，理由是无法核验第三方客户端身份。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NARRATIVE.en: Chat app Threadbridge in %s allows messages between services while keeping existing accounts. Two major platforms refuse access, citing third-party client verification.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_COMMENT.source: 能否互通，会决定一句话能走多远。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_COMMENT.zh_CN: “线桥”允许用户留着原账号跟别的服务互发消息，两家大平台却以无法核验第三方客户端身份为由拒绝接入。理由说的是安全，用户眼下遇到的麻烦却很具体：想联系不同平台上的人，还是得在几个软件之间来回切。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_COMMENT.en: Threadbridge lets users keep their accounts while messaging across services, yet two major platforms refused access over third-party client verification. The reason given is security; the practical result for users is that reaching people on those services still means moving between apps.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s搜索服务“寻径”停止历史网页快照，称维护成本超过广告收入。调查记者发现，数起公共承诺的原始页面在现网站已无法找到。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_NARRATIVE.en: Search service Pathfind in %s removes twenty years of cached pages, citing upkeep costs. Reporters find original pages containing several public promises are also absent from their current sites.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_COMMENT.source: 找不到的原文，会让截图承担更重的争论。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_COMMENT.zh_CN: “寻径”把历史网页快照停了，理由是维护开支超过了广告收入。偏偏调查记者这时候发现，好几起公共承诺的原始页面在现网站上也找不到了，以后想核对当年说过什么，恐怕会更费劲。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_COMMENT.en: Pathfind says it shut down its historical page cache because upkeep costs outgrew ad revenue. Reporters also found that the original pages for several public promises are gone from their current websites, making it harder to verify what was promised years ago.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.zh_CN: %s王室签署《春潮宪章》，将预算和组阁权移交民选议会。旧顾问院保留一年过渡任期，首场公开听证围绕王室地产税展开。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.en: The royal court in %s signs the Springtide Charter, handing budgets and cabinet formation to an elected parliament. An advisory chamber stays for a year; the first public hearing debates tax on royal estates.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.source: 权力移交时，留下的过渡条款也会成为话题。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.zh_CN: 《春潮宪章》把预算和组阁权移交给民选议会，首场公开听证就谈到了王室地产税。旧顾问院还保留着一年过渡任期，新旧权力怎样相处，听听地产税怎么谈，或许就能看出一点来。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.en: The Springtide Charter hands budgets and cabinet formation to an elected parliament, and the first public hearing takes up taxes on royal estates. With the old advisory chamber staying on for a one-year transition, the way that tax is discussed may show something of how the new arrangement will work.

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NEGATIVE.en: The room is burning while the caption insists 'This Is Fine'

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_TITLE.source: “一切正常”的着火房间开始流行
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_TITLE.zh_CN: 配文“一切正常”的着火房间图在职场走红
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_TITLE.en: Burning-room image captioned 'This Is Fine' spreads among workers

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NARRATIVE.source: %s一则配着“一切正常”的着火房间画面流行起来，使用者把明显失控的工作安排写进平静的旁白。
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一则配着“一切正常”的着火房间画面流行起来，使用者把明显失控的工作安排写进平静的旁白。
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NARRATIVE.en: A burning-room image captioned This Is Fine spreads in %s; users pair calm narration with work schedules visibly falling apart.

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_COMMENT.source: 平静与失控之间的落差，就是它的识别点。
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_COMMENT.zh_CN: 房间都烧起来了，画面上还配着一句“一切正常”。大家把明显失控的工作安排写进这段平静的旁白里，不用真发火，看的人也能明白手头的活儿已经乱成什么样了。
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_COMMENT.en: The room is on fire, yet the caption calmly says 'This Is Fine.' By dropping visibly failing work schedules into that composed narration, users can show how badly things are unravelling without raising their voices.

LOC_EVENT_ARCHIVE_REVIVAL_NEGATIVE.en: The film was never shot, yet people are debating its ending in dead earnest

LOC_EVENT_ARCHIVE_REVIVAL_TITLE.en: Film fans invent nonexistent movie Goncharov from misprinted poster

LOC_EVENT_ARCHIVE_REVIVAL_NARRATIVE.source: %s影迷从一张误印海报出发，给并不存在的《贡察洛夫》补出演员、镜头和影评。越来越多人认真讨论从未拍摄的结尾。
LOC_EVENT_ARCHIVE_REVIVAL_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s影迷从一张误印海报出发，给并不存在的《贡察洛夫》补出演员、镜头和影评。越来越多人认真讨论从未拍摄的结尾。
LOC_EVENT_ARCHIVE_REVIVAL_NARRATIVE.en: Film fans in %s turn a misprinted poster into the nonexistent film Goncharov, inventing actors, shots and reviews. More users discuss an ending never filmed.

LOC_EVENT_ARCHIVE_REVIVAL_COMMENT.source: 共同世界只需要一组能反复指认的细节。
LOC_EVENT_ARCHIVE_REVIVAL_COMMENT.zh_CN: 《贡察洛夫》原本只是一张误印海报，影迷却一路补出了演员、镜头和影评。现在连根本没拍过的结尾都有人认真争论，只要大伙儿愿意顺着同一套设定接话，假电影也能聊出真热闹。
LOC_EVENT_ARCHIVE_REVIVAL_COMMENT.en: Film fans have supplied Goncharov with actors, shots, and reviews, and now they are debating an ending that was never filmed. There is no film to watch, but the shared details give people something to recognize and keep adding to. That is enough to keep this particular invention going.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ARCHIVE_RITUAL_TIT.en: Video users imitate purple-milkshake collapse clips

LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_COMMENT.en: An official cultural account named the meme in a notice on low-quality content, calling it repetitive and worthless, and several platforms reduced its recommendation rate. That change gives the judgment a practical effect: people have fewer chances to encounter the phrase. Continuing to circulate it may now take more than repeating the same post.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: 公开指出冒犯能让被忽略的经验进入讨论
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: 被当成笑点的群体发表联名声明指出贬低指代，促使相关社群主动屏蔽
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: A joint statement spells out degrading references and prompts related communities to filter the meme

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: 一句玩笑把没有参与的人也算进了代价
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: 这条模因把特定群体当笑点，相关社群已开始主动屏蔽它
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: Treated as the punchline, the targeted group protests and related communities begin filtering the meme

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: 被指向的群体公开表示受到冒犯
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: 被当笑点的群体发联名声明抗议，相关社群开始屏蔽模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: Targeted group issues joint statement as related communities filter the meme

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: %s一个被这条模因当作笑点的群体发表联名声明，逐项指出其中让成员感到被贬低的指代。相关社群开始主动屏蔽它。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: %s一个被这条模因当作笑点的群体发表联名声明，逐项指出其中让成员感到被贬低的指代。相关社群开始主动屏蔽它。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: A group made the punchline of the meme in %s issues a joint statement identifying references members find degrading. Related communities begin filtering it.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: 被拿来当笑点的人，也会决定传播能否继续。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: 被这条模因当成笑点的群体发了联名声明，把让成员感到受贬低的指代逐项列了出来。相关社群已开始主动屏蔽它。觉得被冒犯的人把理由说出来了，再谈这个玩笑能不能继续，就该把他们的回应听完整。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: The group made the punchline of the meme issued a joint statement listing the references its members find degrading. Related communities have begun filtering it. The people being referred to have explained their objections, and deciding whether to keep sharing the joke should include listening to those reasons.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: 降低刷屏频率能让正常讨论重新出现
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 整理乱刷截图并分享屏蔽词建议，能帮不想看的人清静评论区
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Sharing filter instructions helps users clear unrelated replies out of popular threads

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: 它已经替所有问题提前交了同一份答卷
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 多个热门话题被重复回复占满，“不管说什么都有人刷它”成了新抱怨
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Popular threads fill with repetitive replies until users trade screenshots and filter tips

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: 高频重复引发集体厌烦
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 热门话题遭模因重复刷屏，网友整理截图并流传屏蔽词建议
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Repeated replies flood popular discussions as users share filter instructions

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: %s多个热门话题被这条模因的重复回复占满，用户开始把“不管说什么都有人刷它”的截图放在一起。屏蔽词建议随之流传。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: %s多个热门话题被这条模因的重复回复占满，用户开始把“不管说什么都有人刷它”的截图放在一起。屏蔽词建议随之流传。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Repeated replies using the meme fill popular discussions in %s. Users collect examples of it appearing under unrelated posts and share instructions for filtering it.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: 高曝光不会自动变成持续的好感。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 好几个热门话题被同一句回复占满，用户把无关帖子下刷它的截图攒到一起，连屏蔽词建议都传开了。曝光是有了，看到的人却已经在找办法把它挡住。再继续这样刷，只怕更难等到愿意接话的人。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Several popular discussions are packed with repeated uses of the meme, and users are collecting screenshots from unrelated posts while sharing filter instructions. That is a different sort of visibility: people are learning how to avoid the phrase. Repeating it still more may make it harder to find someone willing to join in.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.source: 追查出处让隐藏的伤害可以被讨论
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.zh_CN: 追出早期使用者的歧视性发言，让转发者开始审视使用时的立场问题
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.en: Uncovering an early user's discriminatory remark makes reposters reconsider what reuse signals

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.source: 作者的旧话替所有转发者补上了未说的立场
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.zh_CN: 追到早期使用者的旧话，转发者也容易被误认为赞同那番话
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.en: Reposting the meme may be mistaken for endorsing an early user’s views

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_T.zh_CN: 早期使用者歧视性发言曝光，引发继续使用是否等于认同的争论
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_T.en: Early user's discriminatory statement sparks debate over continuing to use the meme

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.source: %s网友追出这条模因早期使用者的一段歧视性发言。转发者开始删除旧帖，争论集中在继续使用是否等于认同原作者。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.zh_CN: %s网友追出这条模因早期使用者的一段歧视性发言。转发者开始删除旧帖，争论集中在继续使用是否等于认同原作者。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.en: Readers in %s trace the meme to an early user with a discriminatory statement. Reposters delete older posts as debate turns to whether reuse endorses the source.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.source: 出处争议会把表达与使用者一起拖进讨论。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.zh_CN: 网友追出一名早期使用者的歧视性发言，转发者开始删除旧帖，连一句借来的话也让人犹豫了。大家争的是继续使用是否等于认同原作者，这个问题不能只凭转发过一次就替别人答完。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.en: Readers uncovered a discriminatory remark by an early user, and reposters began deleting older posts. The dispute is about whether using a borrowed phrase also endorses its source. A repost on its own cannot tell us everything the person repeating it believes.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 原始记录帮助读者重新判断引用是否准确
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 原始视频和热门转载下的纠正链接，给读者留下了核对情境的依据
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: Original footage and correction links under major reposts let readers check the quote’s context

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 转发速度比看完视频快了太多
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 模因引用的那句话原本出自另一段情境，部分读者核实后停用了原版本
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: After original footage shows the quote came from another context, some readers drop that version

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 事实核查指出模因引用有误
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 事实核查账号公布原视频，指出模因引语脱离原情境
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: Fact-checking account publishes original footage showing meme quote came from another context

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: %s事实核查账号公布原始视频，证明这条模因引用的那句话来自另一段情境。纠正链接被放在热门转载下，部分读者停止使用原版本。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: %s事实核查账号公布原始视频，证明这条模因引用的那句话来自另一段情境。纠正链接被放在热门转载下，部分读者停止使用原版本。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: A fact-checking account in %s publishes footage showing that the meme quote came from a different context. Corrections appear under major reposts, and some readers stop using that version.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 具体的更正会改变具体的信任。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 事实核查账号放出原始视频，说明模因引用的那句话出自另一段情境。热门转载下有了纠正链接，部分读者也停用了原版本。这回判断那句话该不该信，总算有原片可以对照，不必只跟着转述猜原意。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: A fact-checking account published original footage showing that the meme’s quote came from another context. Correction links appear under major reposts, and some readers have stopped using that version. Those links give people somewhere to check the context before deciding whether to repeat the quote themselves.

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.source: 相同形式也能表达相反立场
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 批评者保留原句式却换上相反画面，借现成形式完成了反讽
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.en: Critics keep the recognizable wording and swap the footage to turn praise into mockery

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.source: 曾经表示支持的一句话成了对支持者的回敬
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 句式没变，底下的画面却换成相反立场，原本的赞同直接变成了嘲讽
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.en: The wording stays intact while opposing footage flips approval into ridicule

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.source: 批评者借用这条模因反讽原来的支持者
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.zh_CN: 批评者社群保留模因句式并配相反画面进行嘲讽
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.en: Critical community pairs original meme wording with opposing footage in mockery

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.source: %s一个批评者社群保留这条模因的句式，把它放到与原支持对象相反的画面上。新版本仍能被认出来，赞同的口吻却成了嘲讽。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一个批评者社群保留这条模因的句式，把它放到与原支持对象相反的画面上。新版本仍能被认出来，赞同的口吻却成了嘲讽。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.en: A critical community in %s keeps the meme wording but places it over footage opposing its original subject. The form stays recognizable while approval turns into mockery.

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.source: 认得出原句，反转才会产生力量。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 批评者社群连句式都没改，只把底下的画面换成跟原支持对象相反的内容，原本赞同的口吻就全变成嘲讽了。大家一眼还认得出是同一套话，正因为认得出，掉转方向时才格外扎人。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.en: A critical community kept the meme’s wording and placed it over footage opposing its original subject. The familiar words still suggest approval, but the footage makes that approval sound mocking. Recognizing the phrase is part of what makes the turn work.

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.source: 新的经验能让既有形式长出新的用途
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 新社群拿它谈论原作之外的生活经验，让同一套表达多了一层用法
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.en: A new community applies the meme to everyday experiences beyond its original subject

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.source: 所有人都在用同一句话，却未必在说同一件事
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 旧用户还认得表面表达，但新旧两边对它到底指什么已经出现分歧
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.en: Older users recognize the surface wording while disagreeing with newcomers on what it refers to

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.source: 新的社群给这条模因赋予另一层含义
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.zh_CN: 新社群借用旧表达，模因指向出现分歧
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.en: New community gives familiar meme a different reference

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.source: %s一个新接触到这条模因的社群，用它谈论原作没有涉及的生活经验。旧用户仍看得懂表面表达，双方对它所指的事情开始分歧。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一个新接触到这条模因的社群，用它谈论原作没有涉及的生活经验。旧用户仍看得懂表面表达，双方对它所指的事情开始分歧。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.en: A community newly encountering the meme in %s uses it for experiences outside its original subject. Older users recognize the surface form but disagree about what it now refers to.

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.source: 语义分叉发生在共同形式仍然存在的时候。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.zh_CN: 新社群拿它聊原作没碰过的生活经验，旧用户还认得表面那句话，两边对它指什么却开始对不上了。往后再转述，恐怕得先问清双方说的是哪件事，不能光凭句子眼熟就认定已经听懂。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.en: A community newly encountering the meme is using it for experiences the original never covered. Older users recognize the wording but disagree with them about what it refers to. Before deciding who has misunderstood whom, it is worth asking which experience each group is talking about.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 新的措辞让原本不熟悉句式的人也能看懂
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 转述成直接说明后，新读者不用先学原句式也能接上同一层意思
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Turning the meme into a direct explanation lets new readers pick up the same meaning

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 意思还在，熟悉的那句话已经不在了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 同一层意思留住了，原先那套标志性的句式却在新读者口中换掉了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: The underlying meaning survives, while the original wording is replaced in new replies

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 网友用直白的说法转述这条模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 网友将模因转述为直接说明，新读者沿用新措辞接话
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Readers retell meme as direct explanation and continue with the new phrasing

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: %s网友把这条模因转述成一段直接的说明，不再沿用原有句式。新读者能理解同一层意思，却开始用这套新措辞继续接话。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: %s网友把这条模因转述成一段直接的说明，不再沿用原有句式。新读者能理解同一层意思，却开始用这套新措辞继续接话。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Readers in %s retell the meme as a direct explanation, replacing its original wording. New readers understand the same meaning and continue using the new phrasing.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 表达换了一套说法，指向仍然可以保持。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 网友没再沿用原来的句式，而是把它转述成一段直接的说明。新读者听懂的还是同一层意思，只是接着聊的时候都改用了这套新措辞，你最初攒出来的那句话反倒退到后面去了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Readers have paraphrased the meme into a direct explanation instead of keeping its original wording. New readers still take the same meaning from it, though they are continuing the conversation with the new phrasing rather than yours.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 换一种说法也能把同一意思传给新人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 换成圈内顺口的说法，也能把原来那层意思传给新人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: The group’s own wording can carry the same meaning to newcomers

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 原作与复述听起来不同，指向却仍然相同
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 原来的表达被圈内新措辞替换，且这套新说法已开始单独流传
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: The group's own wording replaces the original expression and starts circulating on its own

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 社群开始用自己的说法复述模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 兴趣社群用内部说法重述模因，新措辞开始单独流传
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: Interest group retells meme in its own words as new phrasing circulates independently

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: %s一个兴趣社群把这条模因的意思用自己的说法重新讲了一遍。原来的表达被替换，大家仍围绕同一层含义接话，新措辞开始单独流传。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: %s一个兴趣社群把这条模因的意思用自己的说法重新讲了一遍。原来的表达被替换，大家仍围绕同一层含义接话，新措辞开始单独流传。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: An interest group in %s retells the meme meaning in its own words. The original expression is replaced while members keep discussing the same meaning; the new wording begins circulating on its own.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 同一个意思，可能留下几种不同的表达。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 这个兴趣社群把原来的表达换成了他们自己的说法，不过大家接话时聊的还是同一层含义。现在那套新措辞已经开始单独流传，意思算是传过去了，只是换了别人顺嘴的词句。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: An interest group restated the meme’s meaning in its own words, replacing the original expression while keeping the same point in discussion. The new wording is now circulating on its own. The familiar sentence is no longer needed for people in that exchange to refer to the same thing.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.source: 新的场景让形式获得了另一种可用的含义
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.zh_CN: 搬运账号把留下的部分放进别的争论，让现成表达在另一话题里被接走
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.en: Cropping the meme into another dispute gives new readers a ready-made judgment to use

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.source: 没有变的字句也能被搬去指认别的人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.zh_CN: 裁掉原有前后文后，新读者把它当成了对另一个群体的评价
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.en: With the surrounding context cut away, new readers take the meme as a judgment on another group

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.source: 脱离原场景的转载改变了指向
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.zh_CN: 裁掉前后文的转载改变模因指向
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.en: Reposting account cuts context and shifts the meme onto another group

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.source: %s一个搬运账号裁掉这条模因原有的前后文，把剩下的部分用在完全不同的争论里。新读者将它当成对另一群体的评价。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.zh_CN: %s一个搬运账号裁掉这条模因原有的前后文，把剩下的部分用在完全不同的争论里。新读者将它当成对另一群体的评价。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.en: A reposting account in %s cuts the surrounding context and uses the remaining meme in a different dispute. New readers take it as a judgment about another group.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.source: 语境被剪掉以后，剩下的空位会有人填上。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.zh_CN: 搬运账号裁掉前后文，把剩下的部分放进另一场争论，新读者便把它当成了对另一个群体的评价。即便字句没变，原来那件事已经退场了。下一次转发若只认这句熟话，就很容易把新的指向也接过去。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.en: A reposting account cut away the surrounding context and dropped the remaining meme into a different dispute. The words did not change, but new readers took them as a judgment on another group. Someone repeating it from there may be passing on a judgment they never saw in the original setting.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.source: 熟悉的地方经验为表达提供新的共同理解
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.zh_CN: 地方社群结合本地经验重新解释，让它能用来形容当地相似的处境
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.en: Reinterpreting the meme through local experience gives the community a shared term for its own situation

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.source: 名字借来了，原来那件事已经不在场
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.zh_CN: 原来的具体对象变成了泛指，当地人用它说的是另一种相似却不同的处境
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.en: The original target becomes a broad label for a related but different local situation

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.source: 本地社群用模因给自己的处境命名
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.zh_CN: 地方社群以本地经验重释模因，原对象变为泛指
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.en: Local community reinterprets meme through local experience and broadens its target

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.source: %s一个地方社群用本地经验重新解释这条模因。原来的对象变成泛指，大家开始用它描述一种相似却不相同的处境。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.zh_CN: %s一个地方社群用本地经验重新解释这条模因。原来的对象变成泛指，大家开始用它描述一种相似却不相同的处境。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.en: A local community in %s reinterprets the meme through local experience. Its original object becomes a broader label for a related but different situation.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.source: 本地化有时会连同指向一起改写。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.zh_CN: 地方社群拿本地经验把这条模因重新解释了一遍，原来特指的对象变成了泛指，用来形容当地一种相似却不完全相同的处境。话能扎进当地人的日子里，靠的就是这半步转弯。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.en: A local community reinterpreted the meme through its own experience, turning the original target into a broader label for a related but distinct local situation. That slight shift in reference is what lets the phrase take root in local talk.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.source: 共同使用让个人经历有了稳定的表达搭配
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.zh_CN: 上班族反复拿它配加班和绩效排名的表达，让职场吐槽有了固定拍档
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.en: Repeatedly pairing the meme with overtime and ranking jokes gives office workers a steady shorthand

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.source: 原来的意思被每次一起出现的抱怨拉走了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.zh_CN: 反复与加班、绩效并用，让宽泛句式逐渐被读成职场评价
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.en: Repeated pairing with overtime and performance rankings draws a broad phrase toward workplace commentary

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.source: 这条模因与职场梗形成固定搭配
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.zh_CN: 模因与加班、绩效梗形成固定搭配
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.en: Meme forms recurring pairing with overtime and performance-ranking jokes

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.source: %s上班族反复把这条模因与加班、绩效排名的表达放在一起使用。新读者逐渐把原本宽泛的句式理解成对职场规则的评价。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.zh_CN: %s上班族反复把这条模因与加班、绩效排名的表达放在一起使用。新读者逐渐把原本宽泛的句式理解成对职场规则的评价。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.en: Workers in %s repeatedly pair the meme with overtime and performance-ranking jokes. New readers begin reading the formerly broad phrase as a comment on workplace rules.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.source: 经常相邻的表达，会开始分享同一层含义。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.zh_CN: 上班族老把这条模因跟加班、绩效排名的说法放在一块儿用，新读者也就渐渐把它当成了职场评价。反复看到同一类例子，很容易让人以为这句话本来就只适合说这些事。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.en: Workers kept pairing the meme with jokes about overtime and performance rankings. After seeing them together repeatedly, new readers began treating a once-broad phrase as a comment on workplace rules. The recurring pairing gives newcomers a context even if they never saw the phrase used more broadly.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 互相引用让两种表达共享新的联想
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 与“前后对照”并排剪辑并多次转载后，观众只看半句就能想起整个组合
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: After repeated reposts beside a before-and-after format, either half calls up the whole pairing

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 拆开任意一边，观众仍会自动补上另一边
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 两条原本独立的表达合流后，单拿其中半句出来也会自动带出另一半
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Show either half, and viewers supply the other in their heads

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 两套梗被剪进同一个对照模板
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 模因与对照模板合流，半句唤起整组
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Meme and comparison format merge into a recognizable pairing

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: %s创作者把这条模因与另一套“前后对照”的表达并排剪辑。多次转载后，观众开始用其中任意半句唤起整个组合。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: %s创作者把这条模因与另一套“前后对照”的表达并排剪辑。多次转载后，观众开始用其中任意半句唤起整个组合。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Creators in %s place the meme beside a before-and-after format. After repeated reposting, viewers use either half to invoke the whole combination.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 合流需要反复共现，单次拼贴还不够。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 它和“前后对照”的表达并排剪辑，又经过多次转载，观众开始用半句话唤起整组。两套表达反复一起出现，慢慢成了彼此的提示；只拼在一起一次，还不足以让人这样接话。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Creators placed the meme beside a before-and-after format, and after repeated reposting viewers now use either half to call up the whole combination. Repeated co-occurrence bound the two formats together until one automatically brings the other to mind.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.source: 共同暗号让退出争论不必重新解释
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.zh_CN: 固定收尾成了共同暗号，想退出争论时不必再另作解释
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.en: Adding a fixed ending gives users a recognizable way to step out of an overlong argument

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.source: 接话的邀请也被改写成了不想再接话
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.zh_CN: 原本用来引人接话的表达，加上固定收尾后变成了结束对话的信号
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.en: A phrase that once invited replies now signals that its user is done

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.source: 新的收尾句把模因变成退出暗号
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.zh_CN: 网友为模因加上固定收尾，使其变为结束争论的信号
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.en: Readers add fixed ending to meme to signal leaving an argument

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.source: %s网友给这条模因加上一句固定收尾，在争论太久时用它表示不再继续。原本引人接话的表达开始承担结束对话的功能。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.zh_CN: %s网友给这条模因加上一句固定收尾，在争论太久时用它表示不再继续。原本引人接话的表达开始承担结束对话的功能。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.en: Readers in %s add a fixed ending to the meme to signal leaving an overlong argument. A phrase that invited replies begins serving as a way to end them.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.source: 收尾改变了这句话在对话里的用途。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.zh_CN: 网友给它接上了一句固定收尾，争论拖得太久时发出来，意思就是不再往下接了。原本用来引人搭腔的话，多加这一截尾巴，在对话里起到的作用就从开场变成了散场。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.en: Readers added a fixed ending to the meme and now use it when an argument drags on too long. With that ending attached, a phrase that used to invite replies has taken on the job of ending the exchange.
